name: K3s
description: Fully conformant, production-ready lightweight Kubernetes distribution by Rancher, designed for edge, IoT, CI, ARM, and resource-constrained environments with single binary under 100MB.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Rancher provides k3s Docker images available to run k3s server and agent from Docker, with a docker-compose.yml example in the repository.

eval_notes: Lightweight Kubernetes for edge nodes (512MB RAM, 200MB disk). Foundation for many edge platforms. Ideal for testing containerized workloads on resource-constrained edge hardware.
